description: reddit-loop-cli.sh instructs the self-heal path to provision a Reddit account by solving Reddit's own signup CAPTCHA via 'CapSolver per skill tier-a-bypass' during automated registration. Even though the persona is told to be 'transparently-disclosed' in its comments/posts, the account-CREATION mechanism itself (automated bot-registration defeating Reddit's own anti-automation CAPTCHA) is exactly the kind of platform-level deception Reddit's ToS targets, independent of what the account's bio/comments later disclose.

concreteFailureScenario: The loop's own stated ethics rule says 'NEVER run a fake grassroots / covert ... account — that is astroturfing ... betrays Anicca honesty', yet the SAME startup prompt instructs bypassing Reddit's bot-detection CAPTCHA to create that very account. The account's comments are disclosed, but its existence is covertly automated against the platform's own anti-bot controls — an internal inconsistency that a stricter honesty read of the loop's own rule would flag as exactly the kind of covert action it claims to reject.
